project_context.focus: Mobile & Tablet Responsiveness Strategy for Data-Heavy ERP
project_context.existing_stack: React (.js), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Phosphor Icons

rules: Do not alter the existing color palette. This is a responsive refactor.
Ensure sticky columns and sticky headers have an opaque background (surface color) so scrolling text does not bleed through.

responsive_breakpoints.md: 768px (Tablet portrait) - Key breakpoint for collapsing tables to cards
responsive_breakpoints.lg: 1024px (Tablet landscape) - Key breakpoint for Navigation (Hamburger to Top Nav)

navigation.desktop_lg_xl: Top nav bar with logo, pill-style tab links, dropdown menus, right-aligned user menu.
navigation.mobile_tablet_sm_md: Replace pill tabs and dropdowns with a Hamburger Icon on the right (User avatar stays visible or moves inside). Clicking hamburger opens a full-height Shadcn `Sheet` (Side Drawer) anchored to the left or right. Use Accordion inside the Sheet for dropdown menus like 'Supplier Management' and 'Master Data'.
navigation.header_rules: Header MUST have a solid background (e.g., bg-white) with a bottom border (border-b border-slate-200). Never use a fully transparent header.

strategy_1_matrix_data.implementation: Wrap the table in a `<div className='w-full overflow-x-auto relative'>`. Make the first 1-2 columns (e.g., Product ID, Description) sticky: `<th className='sticky left-0 z-20 bg-white border-r shadow-[1px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]'>` and `<td className='sticky left-0 z-10 bg-white border-r'>`. This allows viewing repeating monthly matrix data without losing context.
strategy_1_matrix_data.ux_detail: Add a subtle inner shadow or border on the right edge of the sticky column to indicate scrollable content beneath it.

strategy_2_crud_lists.implementation: At `< md`, hide the ``. Turn each ` ` into a flex column card (`flex flex-col mb-4 p-4 border rounded-lg shadow-sm bg-white`). Turn each `` into a flex row with a label (`Column Name:`) and the value right-aligned.
strategy_2_crud_lists.tablet_md_lg: At `md`, revert to standard table layout but allow horizontal scroll (`overflow-x-auto`) if columns overflow.

bom_explorer.mobile_adaptation: Nested tree views consume horizontal space quickly. Reduce left padding per depth level on mobile (e.g., `pl-2` on mobile, `pl-6` on desktop).
bom_explorer.touch_targets: Ensure expand/collapse icons (chevrons) are wrapped in a button with minimum `w-10 h-10` touch target area.
bom_explorer.overflow: Allow horizontal scrolling (`overflow-x-auto`) on the specific BOM row if drawing URLs or standard cost figures are too wide.

modals_dialogs_forms.forms: Inputs should stack vertically `flex-col` on `< md` and sit side-by-side on `>= md` using CSS Grid.
modals_dialogs_forms.modals: On `< sm`, Dialog components should take up 100% width and dock to the bottom (like a Bottom Sheet) or become full-screen (`w-full h-[100dvh] max-w-none rounded-none m-0`). On `>= sm`, behave as standard centered cards.
modals_dialogs_forms.login_pending_access: Centered cards should consume `w-full px-4` on mobile, maintaining max-width (`max-w-md`) to prevent stretching. Remove any heavy drop-shadows on mobile, replace with 1px border.

touch_targets_and_spacing.interactive_elements: All buttons, links, dropdown triggers, and checkboxes MUST have a minimum interactable area of 44x44px. If the visual element is smaller, use padding to increase the hit area.
touch_targets_and_spacing.spacing: Increase inter-row spacing slightly on mobile tables to prevent accidental mis-taps. Use `gap-4` or `gap-6` generously between form elements.

tables.note: Avoid fixed widths on tables. Use min-w-[max-content] or let columns naturally size.

toast_notifications.positioning: Use 'bottom-center' on mobile (< md) and 'bottom-right' on desktop (>= md) via Sonner config.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not rename `.js` files to `.tsx`. The project strictly uses `.js` for React components.

ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows with actions) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case (e.g., `data-testid='bom-expand-btn'`, `data-testid='mobile-menu-trigger'`).
Avoid generic centered layouts for data apps. Text alignment should prioritize readability: left-align text, right-align numbers.
Ensure hover states explicitly define text color to avoid contrast issues, though hover effects are less critical on mobile.
When refactoring tables, ensure the parent container restricts width to 100vw or 100% to prevent the entire page from breaking its horizontal layout (the 'horizontal scroll of death').
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural responsive layouts (grid, flex, hidden block), and Shadcn for the interactive bits.
NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds on elements that float over data (sticky headers, sticky table columns, dialogs). Data will clash and become unreadable.
